descriptionByLocale.it:
We are looking for an intern at our Visp site. In this position you will be part of the Microbial HPLC laboratory team. What you’ll get:
• ​A dynamic, agile career path with room to grow
• An inclusive, ethical, and supportive workplace culture
• A comprehensive benefits package tailored to your role and location What you will do:
• Support day-to-day QC activities
• Support project scientists and project leaders
• Perform laboratory activities under GxP conditions
• Document and present accurate data
• Support the maintenance of a GxP laboratory environment What we are looking for:
• Practive integrated Bachlor Student
• Proficiency in German and good communication skills in English and other languages are a valuable plus
• You are interested in being a reliable team member in a multi-cultural environment. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
